ns0:g.ns0:text: Constant-head and falling-head tests use different measurements to recover hydraulic conductivity
Saturated homogeneous specimens, negligible apparatus losses and compatible length/time units. Constant-head K uses collected volume ΔV, not discharge rate.
Falling-head h values are head differences relative to the outlet reference; use natural log, or2.303log10. End connections and standpipe shapes are conceptual, not
